text_block_list.text: I... won? Against Teio? Me?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Haha, hahaha...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I don't believe it... Did I... really?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Awww, I lost!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Teio... I—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: You just inspired me!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
This is proof that I can get even faster!
Hehe, I'm
already excited!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I wonder how much farther I have to go
till I hit
my peak... Time to step it up and
get there in a
flash!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Wait...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: That was too close. I almost got cocky.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Wake up, Nature. You just... got lucky.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Because, I mean... there's no way that...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I could shine brighter than she does.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I was when I won, of course. But...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
This can't be anything but luck. I don't
have what
it takes to be a winner.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I mean, it makes no sense. There's no
way I'm
actually faster than Teio.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
There's nothing about me that shines
above the
pack. Something must have
gone wrong.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
There's no way I would win in a test of
skill. If we
race again... I'll definitely
lose.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! I can't believe I thought I had
actual
talent for a second there! I want
to crawl into a
hole!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: But Найс Нэйчер did win, and it was her own abilities that brought about that victory. And yet...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Gosh, that's embarrassing.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Her lack of confidence in her abilities
has caused
her to doubt her
achievements and react as if she
lost
today. In this case, what she needs is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Nature, do you wanna go on a little trip?

text_block_list.text: A trip? But why now?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Let's go get a win this summer.

text_block_list.text:
It's a risky gamble to ask her to compete
in the
Classics right now. She could lose
what little
confidence she has.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Winning at local races and steadily
accumulating
wins will be better for her
overall growth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Are you saying... I'm not going to be
competing in
the Satsuki Sho or
Japanese Derby?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Because I'm not good enough?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
Right now, we should focus on building your
confidence in your skills.

text_block_list.text: Okay.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You're right. Right now, even if I won
those races,
I wouldn't accept it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: After this summer, you'll be even faster.

text_block_list.text: I hope that's the case.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Okay, then! Touring in a caravan is more
my style,
anyway.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But we're not actually doing that, are
we?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: What kind of race are you thinking of?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
A graded race that takes place in
Kokura... the
perfect race for Nice
Nature to gain some
confidence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Huh, that one is the same distance as
Wakagoma,
right? I think that's a good
idea.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But summer in Kokura... Yay... I love
sweating...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide to aim for the Kokura
Kinen
next!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
